sources.title: Zee Entertainment Announces ₹600 Crore Buyback at ₹91 per Share, Tender Window Opens on 1 December 2026

synopsis: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited has announced a share buyback worth up to ₹600 crore at ₹91 per share, covering up to 6.86% of its paid-up equity capital. The tendering window opens on 1 December 2026 and closes on 7 December 2026, with settlement and payment scheduled by 14 December 2026. Eligible shareholders held shares on the record date of 25 November 2026. The company's promoters and promoter group, holding 3.99% of the paid-up equity capital, have chosen not to tender their shares. The repurchase will be funded using internal accruals, surplus funds, cash balances, or current investments, without any borrowed funds. Emkay Global Financial Services Limited is acting as the manager and company broker, while MUFG Intime India Private Limited serves as the registrar.
